Questions & Answers
How does Design DNA maintain visual coherence?

Design DNA treats curvature, contrast, and whitespace as numeric dimensions mapped to project tokens.

Can I export to other frameworks like Vue or Svelte?

V1 is canonically targeted to React + TypeScript + Tailwind 4. Additional AST emitters can be added cleanly.

What happens if my network goes offline?

Tessellate operates guest-first in memory with local IndexedDB persistence, running fully offline.

How do you prevent breaking updates?

Every resource is immutable by schema version. Upgrades use verified migration scripts.

Engineered for durability across every layer of the interface.

Six architectural pillars powering the Tessellate composition runtime.

01
Zero Runtime Lock-In

Exports directly to clean React and Tailwind CSS without hidden proprietary libraries.

02
Deterministic DNA

Enforces mathematical harmony across spacing, curvature, typography, and contrast.

03
Sub-Millisecond Parsing

Validates entire component trees in microseconds using local Zod schemas.

04
Accessible by Default

Meets WCAG 2.2 AA standards with full keyboard traversal and contrast tokens.

05
Agent-Ready Registry

Equipped with OpenAPI, llms.txt, and MCP servers for autonomous coding tools.

06
Guest-First Storage

Operates completely client-side with optional GitHub OAuth for cloud sync.
